LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_Impact_Watch: The Conclave watches the colony's sky for {0} days: each cold snap, heat wave, fallout or other hard turn of the sky the storyteller sends waits a day, and a vial-runner comes to the gate with the warning first.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_GlassHeld: {RUNNER}, a {WORD} of {FACTION}, is on the way to the gate with the Conclave's warning: the glass has seen a hard turn of the colony's sky coming, not today but soon: {CONDITION}.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_GlassHeldWord: Word has come from {FACTION}: the Conclave's glass has seen a hard turn of the colony's sky coming, not today but soon: {CONDITION}.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_GlassHeldFields: The colony's fields that sow by the weather have reckoned it in already.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_GlassRunnerSays: {0} on the way, the glass says, so bring in what you can.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_RodNoRoof: The roof the rod was meant for is gone.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_Impact_Rod: The storm-walker sets the rod up in the {0}: lightning that falls on the open ground within {1} cells of it strikes the rod instead, harmlessly, and the colony reads its weather as by a weather station.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_RodSet: {PAWN} has set up the Conclave's rod under the colony's highest roof. The lightning that falls near it will strike the rod now.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_RodStruck: Lightning struck the Conclave's rod, and nothing caught fire.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_NoReader: Nobody at home can learn the glass now.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_Impact_Taught: {0} reads the weather as the Conclave does for a season: the forecasts are nearer the truth.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_ApprenticeSays: Every star where the book says it should be, and one that isn't.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_Apprentice_Coming: {0} is on the road from the Conclave's tower.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_Apprentice_Staying: {0} is studying the colony's sky. Clear nights watched: {1}.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_NoSoil: There's no open soil round the colony for saplings.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_Impact_Saplings: {0} saplings planted on open soil round the colony, out of its fields and buildings, one after another.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_SaplingsPlanted: {PAWN} of the Mossborn has planted the saplings round the colony.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_GraveTreeGone: {0}'s grave has no open soil beside it now.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_Impact_GraveTree: A grove-warden plants a sapling beside {0}'s grave, a tree of the land's own.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_GraveTreePlanted: {PAWN} of the Mossborn planted a sapling beside the grave.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_Impact_Tend: The tree-connector prunes the Gauranlen tree a while: its bond grows {0}% stronger.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_TreeTended: {PAWN} of the Mossborn pruned the Gauranlen tree, and its bond with {CONNECTOR} is the stronger for it.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_LedgerWarm: {FACTION} have reckoned the colony's trees for the season, {FELLED} felled and {PLANTED} planted, and think better of it for the planting.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_LedgerCool: {FACTION} have reckoned the colony's trees for the season, {FELLED} felled and {PLANTED} planted, and think less of it for the axe.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_NoCamp: The squad has no ground to camp on now.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_NoFighter: Nobody at home can take the drill now.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_Impact_Hire: A squad of {0} makes camp by the colony for {1} days and takes up arms against whatever comes at it. Every {2} days its wage of {3} silver is asked by letter; unpaid, the squad walks.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_Impact_HireGuard: The squad fights for the colony while its camp stands
LanguageData.CC_Camp_End_unpaid: The {NAME} from {FACTION} went unpaid, so they struck their camp {PLACE} and walked, as the Banner always does. The Roll will remember the contract broken.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_DeserterHeard: {0} heard that the colony took in {1}, whom the Banner struck from the Roll.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_Impact_Night: {0} sleeps in a warm corner tonight and is on the road at first light.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_NoMaker: {0} can't work at the bench now.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_NoBench: The colony has no bench to make the {0} at.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_Impact_Commission: {PAWN_nameDef} makes the {THING} at the bench from the stuff set apart for it; {OTHER_nameDef} comes back for it and pays by its quality
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_WanderSays: A good bench, and a better teacher.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_Wander_Coming: {0} is on the road from the guildhall.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesE_Wander_Staying: {0} is at the colony on the wander-year. Days at the bench: {1}.
